note: The one quantity both counters observe: response body octets, after HTTP framing is stripped and chunked transfer-encoding is decoded, as they cross into the tunnel. The node counts them in SessionMeter::observe; the gateway counts them as TunnelMeterRecord.to_consumer. Both processes read this file and must pin the same number, because the epoch challenger compares them at exact equality with no tolerance. origin_socket_bytes is the WRONG seam, recorded here as a negative control so a meter that drifts back onto the socket is caught by a red test instead of by a forfeited bond.
